invariant: A syntactically titled separator whose trimmed title is empty still contains the Java fallback space atom, used identically by width and paint.
causal_divergence: Rust retains Some("") and emits zero-width title text; Java inserts a single space before computing and painting the title block.
planned_change: Normalize empty titled content to the space atom at component construction so measurement, line gap and painting share it; retain body and wrapper ordering.
perturbation_axes: space-only versus nonempty/untitled and repeated sections
